quest.title: Question and Answer
quest.description: Swan does everything by the book — specifically, by the Knights of Favonius Handbook. Previously, Swan wouldn't ask anything of the Traveler, who was not a Knight then. Now that the Traveler is an Honorary Knight, Swan will sometimes quiz the Traveler concerning the contents of the Handbook.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x20000, Mondstadt Hash Brown x5

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, the Knights are so strict...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: You got them all correct. As expected of our Honorary Knight — such questions were no problem for you at all.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: To be honest, there are some locals who can't answer some of these questions.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Please, take this as a gift.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Stormterror's Lair

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Strange yet respectable traveler

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Acting Grand Master

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Now, please listen to my questions.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: To the northwest of Mondstadt are some ruins. Legend holds that it was once a city where a tyrant ruled from his tower. It has since been occupied by Dvalin, who shelters himself there.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: My question is this: What is the official name now given to these ruins by the Knights of Favonius?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Dvalin's Den

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Stormy Terry's Tower

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Correct! The ruins are indeed called "Stormterror's Lair."

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: ...I see you've chosen to go your own way on how to remember some of these things.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: But the official name given to that place by the Knights is in fact "Stormterror's Lair."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Alright, let's begin.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need to swot up a little more...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Okay then... Make sure you read through it carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Next question. Listen carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: According to knightly etiquette, what is the proper form of address to use when speaking to unknown individuals encountered within Mondstadt's borders?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sneaky little bard's-turd

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Burgeoning storm

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Correct, "strange yet respectable traveler," or indeed "travelers," is the correct way to address those that we meet here who hail from lands beyond.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Ahem, no. The correct form is "strange yet respectable traveler." I must stress that you cannot afford to be hazy on such details as an Honorary Knight.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Now for my last question.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: As I'm sure you are completely aware, the affairs of the Knights of Favonius within the city walls are currently under the management of Ms. Jean. My question, then, is: What is Ms. Jean's official title?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Master

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Dandelion Tights

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Precisely. Jean's role is that of "Acting Grand Master."

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: No. Jean's title is "Acting Grand Master," and I strongly advise you to remember it...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Alright, that was all from me. Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, the Knights are so strict...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Hmm... Unfortunately, you didn't answer them all correctly.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: But I think that you did a good job, considering the circumstances. Please take this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, the Knights are so strict...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Hmm, I think it best that you read the Knights of Favonius Handbook again.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: You are an Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius, after all. It wouldn't do if you weren't familiar with Mondstadt at all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, the Knights are so strict...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Hmm... Unfortunately, you didn't answer them all correctly.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: But I think that you did a good job, considering the circumstances. Please take this.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Ready?
